meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能用命令行跑电商流水线：从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据（翻译标题、算利润率）、生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok 上架模板、写推广方案和短视频，还能挖爆品趋势、闲鱼捡漏评分、一键代发。
howto.when: 当你需要做跨境电商的选品、上架、推广等业务，或想在闲鱼二手选品捡漏时触发。

say.text: 帮我在1688采集蓝牙耳机，抓详情并下载图片
把采集的商品清洗一下，过滤掉毛利率低于20%的
用闲鱼捡漏搜投影仪，预算999，要求4K和云台

howto.what_en: Claude gains a CLI e-commerce pipeline: scrape 1688 products, clean data, generate WeChat Shop/Shopify/TikTok listing templates, write promo copy and 9:16 videos, mine trending products, score Xianyu bargains, and fulfill 1688 orders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need cross-border e-commerce work such as product selection, listing, or promotion, or want to hunt Xianyu second-hand bargains.

say_en.text: Scrape Bluetooth earphones on 1688 with details and images
Clean the scraped products and drop ones under 20% margin
Hunt Xianyu for a projector under 999 with 4K and gimbal
